leadText: Tyler Bunch is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of . Until , he was usually credited as H.D. Quinn. He is currently affiliated with Clear Talent Group Agency and Innovative Artists.
plainText:
Tyler Bunch is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of . Until , he was usually credited as H.D. Quinn. He is currently affiliated with Clear Talent Group Agency and Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Bunch was born February 10, 1970, in Tahlequah, Oklahoma. He joined during the fifteenth season. His most prominent roles are that of , Team Flare leader Lysandre, Ash's Hawlucha, and Professor Kukui's Incineroar.

Outside of voice acting, Bunch is a prolific puppeteer.
